subject: Credit issuance request — SaltMine trial expansion / suspicious signups
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Credit issuance request - SaltMine trial expansion

Hi team,

Quick one — SaltMine (Alex Lim, "alex.lim@saltmine.ai") has asked for an extension/top-up to their self-serve trial. They want to run a short POC with higher token allowance (~1M tokens) to demo to their platform team next week.

I validated the account and the customer is actively using the API, but our signals flagged a cluster of related accounts that may be duplicates. I'm attaching the signup log + a small sample of accounts they provided for the POC.

Attachments: signup_log.csv (csv), account_samples.txt (txt)

Can we get a quick fraud check? If it passes, I want to manually issue an extra 1,000,000 tokens for two weeks and mark it as a one-time promo. If not, we should hold and ask for org verification.

Next step I need from security: go/no-go and any conditional gating we should apply.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Credit issuance request - SaltMine trial expansion

Ben — thanks for the heads up.

Please hold on manual issuance. I'll triage but need the device / behavioral signals and any unusual headers. Laura, can you pull: 
- device_signals_export.zip for the last 90 days (per the signup ids in the CSV)
- any matching IP CIDR ranges and UA strings
- a 10-account sample export with timestamps

I'm opening INF-3121 to track the investigation: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3121

If we see rotated subdomains, identical UA fingerprints, or clear proxy clusters, we should deny the manual credit and request company-level verification from SaltMine (billing contact or corporate email). If signals are clean, we can provision a reduced monitored allowance and set automatic rollback on anomalous consumption.

cc: Laura for the exports.

—Stephanie
Security Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Credit issuance request - SaltMine trial expansion

Stephanie / Ben — I pulled the samples and ran a quick signals correlation. Summary:

- 47 signups in the last 30 days tied to the SaltMine organization claim; 31 of those share a small set of IP ranges (3 contiguous /24s).
- Several email handles use rotating subdomains (e.g., hires@acquired.saltmine.ai, dev@trial3.saltmine.ai) rather than corporate-only domains.
- UA strings are nearly identical across ~80% of the sample and include an uncommon robot-like header sequence.
- Two accounts show matching device fingerprints + identical account creation timestamps to the second.

Attachments: device_signals_export.zip (zip) — contains per-account IP/UA/timestamp export. account_samples.txt (txt) contains the 10-account sample you requested.

Recommendation: hold manual issuance. These are classic indicators of bulk / scripted signups. If the customer can provide a corporate billing email and a short PO or verification from an identifiable admin, we can re-evaluate. Otherwise, deny the top-up.

If you want, we can provide a smaller, conditional allocation (e.g., 250k tokens) with consumption throttles and a 48-hour watch window.

Laura Bennett
Risk & Trust | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Lim <alex.lim@saltmine.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Credit issuance request - SaltMine trial expansion

Alex — quick update from our side.

Thanks for your excitement about Redwood — excited to see the POC. Our security / trust team is doing a short signals review before we manually extend trial credits. On initial review there are a few anomalies (rotating subdomains, overlapping IP ranges) that we need to clear up.

Could you send: 
- a corporate billing email (admin@ or billing@) or a PO from SaltMine;
- a brief note on the expected usage pattern for the POC (approx tokens/day and who will share keys);
- confirmation that the accounts are controlled by distinct employees (not test automation).

If it's easier, here's a short verification form: https://forms.gle/redwood-trial-verification (please copy to Sid in ops if helpful).

On our side, Laura has recommended holding the full issuance. We can provision a monitored 250k token allowance temporarily if you provide the billing contact and confirm usage—otherwise we'll need to pause issuance until verification arrives.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to hop on a 15-min call if that helps.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Alex Lim <alex.lim@saltmine.ai>, security@saltmine.ai
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2026 16:03:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Credit issuance request - SaltMine trial expansion

Alex / SaltMine ops — thanks for the quick responses so far. Looping in the SaltMine security contact so we can clear this quickly.

Internal summary for the record: INF-3121 contains the full exports. Laura's signal review shows several clustering signals consistent with scripted signups; we are therefore pausing full manual credit issuance.

Offer to SaltMine: to keep the POC moving, Redwood can provision a limited monitored allowance of 250,000 tokens for 7 days under the following conditions:
- Provide a corporate billing email or PO (billing@ or admin@ domain)
- Confirm distinct employee ownership for the accounts used in the POC
- Enable two specific controls on your side (share list of intended IP CIDRs and agree to pacing limits in writing)

If SaltMine provides the verification requested we will uplift to the originally requested allowance and remove throttles. Failure to provide verification will result in immediate rollback of the temporary allowance and a full manual review.

Attachments included to help SaltMine correlate: account_samples.txt (10-account sample)

Next steps: Alex / Sid, please reply with a billing contact + brief PO or else confirm you accept the conditional 250k allocation and will share the CIDR list. Ben will coordinate any PO paperwork with your team.

—Stephanie
Security Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
